items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: You announce one tune here as “one by Benny Aranoff”... your own tune is “Me and My Half Wit.”

ctx.x: You have one of your own tunes on here, “Huggles,” which you, I think you have a sense of humor. You announce one tune here as “one by Benny Aranoff” is that — © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
— with his usual sly wit and then your own tune is “Me and My Half Wit.”
